Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(EmailInput.Text) Or 
    IsBlank(UsernameInput.Text) Or 
    IsBlank(PasswordInput.Text) Or 
    IsBlank(ConfirmPasswordInput.Text) Or 
    IsBlank(ContactInput.Text),
    Notify("Please fill in all fields", NotificationType.Error),

    !IsMatch(EmailInput.Text, Match.Email),
    Notify("Please enter a valid email address", NotificationType.Error),

    PasswordInput.Text <> ConfirmPasswordInput.Text,
    Notify("Passwords do not match", NotificationType.Error),

    !IsBlank(LookUp(LifeguardDetails, Email = EmailInput.Text)),
    Notify("An account with this email already exists", NotificationType.Error),

    Patch(
        LifeguardDetails,
        Defaults(LifeguardDetails),
        {
            Title: UsernameInput.Text,
            Email: EmailInput.Text,
            Username: UsernameInput.Text,
            Password: PasswordInput.Text,
            'Re - Enter Password': ConfirmPasswordInput.Text,
            'Contact Number': ContactInput.Text,
            'Selected Beaches': "",
            'Beach Today': "",
            SlotToday: ""
        }
    );
    Set(varVolunteer, LookUp(LifeguardDetails, Email = EmailInput.Text));
    Notify("Account created successfully!", NotificationType.Success);
    Navigate('Volunteer-Page 1')
)
